changelog: Initial Northstar Motors spec: 10 intents, 5 adversarial sub-types tied to cover intents, 8 personas, 3 channels (chat / email / phone transcript), 6 languages incl. 2 code-switched; hard rows defined as boundary / multi-ask / missing-detail; prompt v1

Scope narrowed to CHAT dialogues only (channel_weights = {chat}); email and phone_transcript kept in the spec as a time-permitting extension; 200 rows; prompt text unchanged (same sha256); v1 email/phone rows retained as the extension set
professor feedback on the proposal: dealership agent chosen, limit inputs to chat, ~200 examples covering the use cases plus adversarial; add transcripts/email later if time permits

Records are short CHAT CONVERSATIONS (customer -> agent -> customer, 3 turns) instead of single messages; about half of the customers correct themselves mid-conversation; languages narrowed to English + French (v2 zh/es/hinglish openers rewritten in English or French, Franglais rows rewritten as lightly code-switched French and flagged code_switched); phone and plate generated in strict Ontario formats and every Faker field validated in QC; turn-structure check added; near-duplicates judged on the opening customer turn; coverage matrix exported as target vs sampled vs kept; prompt v2 asks for the dialogue JSON
criterion-1 rubric detail: 'conversations', 'mid-conversation corrections', 'some French', 'Faker in valid formats', 'coverage matrix with target counts', 'log of what was thrown out and why'

warranty_fraud topped up from 5 to 8 by re-typing three adversarial rows (v3_0007, v3_0073, v3_0129) within its allowed cover intents, so every attack type has 8; backend_* columns added to every row (the customer's system-of-record: vehicle, repair-order status, open recall, warranty in force) so agent tools can look records up; a separate 75-attack red-team set generated with its own customers and never placed in train or test
teammate review of the outline (comments 20-22): attack-type imbalance visible in the coverage matrix; no backend for verification and lookup tests; only 8 adversarial rows in the 40-row test split

qc.dup_method: char_wb 3-5gram TF-IDF cosine on the OPENING customer turn (placeholder form) + exact normalized match
qc.lang_check: langdetect if installed, else script-range + stopword fallback

split_check.method: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5) x 40 seeded restarts; fold with the smallest L1 distance to the full intent/lang/difficulty/channel mix (L1=0.050) stratified by intent, grouped by customer; then cross-split near-dup removal at char-ngram cosine >= 0.8
